source_grain.maternal_source_gt_match_to_field: All matched mothers have exact SC/SI concordance; no separate S-allele compatibility estimate
source_grain.marker_calling: Six loci; need >=4 jointly typed loci; nonmaternal allele at any locus is observed-outcross lower-bound; not full MLTR

primary_target: per-mother lower-bound fraction of at least four genotyped children carrying a nonmaternal marker allele
predictors_M0: year2015+SC+year2015:SC+log1p(total lifetime flowers)+days-to-flower/30+maternal heterozygous locus fraction
predictors_M1: M0 + log1p((AH+BF counted site-year field visits)/(open flower-hours))
method: train-only standardized logit[(k+0.5)/(n-k+0.5)] ridge lambda 1; predict sigmoid, mother-weighted Brier on empirical k/n; 4 entire site holdouts

source_definitions.official_array_codes: BF bee-fly, F other fly, B honeybee or carpenter bee, L lepidoptera; 2014 temporal-sheet B Butterfly conflicts, keep both grounded descriptions
source_definitions.publication_visit_count: 3748 official visits not reconciled to 6702 original position tokens

scientific_limitations: Effect is small (0.00046 absolute mother-weighted Brier, 0.70% relative) and 24-43 fold difference nearly zero; cannot claim strong mechanism or practical value
Four sites inside one original study; no leave-study or independent region transfer
Original paper already reports MLTR outcrossing SI 0.877-0.992 and SC 0.186-0.397: current raw allele indicator reuses the same material; not a new independent mating-system discovery
Observed nonmaternal allele is a lower bound on genetic outcrossing; undetected outcross and genotyping errors possible
S-locus marker class and experimental SC/SI fully correspond, so no separate compatibility mechanism identified
Source-effective AH/BF visits are not verified effective compatible pollen deposition, and official 3748 visit definition unresolved
Mother-level nuisance genotype sensitivity is only partially represented by heterozygous locus fraction
Original archived source not redistributed; result report is aggregate only
Do not replace LA001 or LA002 frozen seed-count primary negative results or infer a natural urban/island convergence law
method_inference: Prespecified within-one-programme conditional predictive gate passed. No conventional independent-site confidence interval or causal effect claimed; exploratory real-data test.
